name: zoo
description: Nodes correspond to animals in the Zoo database and use integer ids. Hyperedges correspond to shared attributes, i.e., each hyperedge contains the set of animals that share a given attribute. Node metadata records the animal name and type class.

hypergraph_metadata.weighted: (BOOL) Whether the hypergraph is weighted (e.g., false).

nodes_metadata.animal_name: (STRING) Animal name from the source row (e.g., aardvark).

edges_metadata.name: (STRING) Attribute name with value suffix (e.g., eggs-0=no eggs, eggs-1=lays eggs).
